notes: SOURCE: structural copy of Level 37 (the procedural chunks reuse levels/L037/L037_cells.gd and L037_kinds.gd read-only, so tiles, pools, pillar lattices, stair pits, corridors and basins are literally Level 37's grammar); progressive attenuation of all light sources, native and foreign (wells, panels, underwater lamps and the flashlight dim together); water turns viscous (wading and swimming slow); once darkness is complete the water takes a red tint and bright red sprouts light the level; faint distant chants that draw wanderers and, with long exposure, can be parsed ('the mother's gift', 'a place in paradise'); rumoured water effects only as an unverified wanderers' page and a drink interaction with no effect; damaged camera with paraphrased transcript and the glitched last frame (TESTIMONY); Ambassadors fly past.
